relations_to.summary: Saudi Arabia was among 21 states in the joint statement rejecting Israel's recognition of Somaliland (26 Dec 2025) and urging its revocation; the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation endorsed the statement. The foreign ministry backs Somalia's unity and territorial integrity.
